name: Screen Direction Validation
purpose: Check eyelines, camera axis, character look direction and movement vectors between shots.
scope: Bounded continuity_state capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for screen_direction_validation.
Execute the bounded operation: Check eyelines, camera axis, character look direction and movement vectors between shots.
Apply screen_direction_validation-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to director, qc_supervisor.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run screen_direction_validation on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask screen_direction_validation to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
